provider: firestorage.jp (ファイヤーストレージ)

free_tier.stated: Unregistered and free-member tiers: per-file max 300 GiB, unlimited number of uploads. The free *member* storage drive is only 2 GiB (25 GiB light, 100 GiB regular) — the 'capacity unlimited' claim applies to the transfer service, not the drive.
free_tier.notes: the headline offer as the seed recorded it; the binding constraint is in limits[]

per_object_cap.notes: extracted from the quota or limits prose

retention.stated: Retention: user-selectable, '最長で14日間' on オクル, default 3 days; if unset the operator deletes on its own algorithm

egress.terms: No bandwidth metering on the free tiers; paid tiers sell storage GB and ad removal, not transfer.

tooling: Web upload form (オクル) only; no documented public API for the free tier. Member drive has no WebDAV.
chaining: Account-less uploads so 300 GiB per object x unlimited objects, but each object has a hard expiry, so chaining is a re-upload loop rather than accumulation.

limits_note: 300 GiB per file. Retention: user-selectable, '最長で14日間' on オクル, default 3 days; if unset the operator deletes on its own algorithm. TOP-page anonymous upload is separately capped at 2 GiB — the 300 GiB path requires the オクル flow.

reliability_note: Two different caps on the same site (2 GiB from the front page, 300 GiB via オクル) is a real trap for any wrapper: the naive POST silently hits the 2 GiB ceiling. Deleted files are unrecoverable by policy.
